title: SandboxPartnerMadePayload
description: Payload of `sandbox.partner.made` version 1. A Partner's sandbox twin was made, at its first sandbox key or its owner's first reset, from its Locations, services and published menus. Consumers: the Partner console's checklist, analytics. The twin is never listed, paid out or messaged. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

twin_partner_id.description: The twin, the Partner the sandbox keys act on.

key_id.description: The sandbox key whose creation made it; `null` when its owner made it.

locations.description: How many Locations the twin has.
